name: Animate! Orlando
blurb: A three-day anime and animation convention from GalaxyCon with voice actors, animation veterans, cosplay guests and wrestlers.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'August 13-15, 2027' and 'We look forward to seeing you AUGUST 13-15, 2027 at the Orange County Convention Center.'

notes: Guest cards show only name + which days, no show credits, so Known for is left blank throughout; categories are from general knowledge, with 'other' used where a name could not be confidently placed. Skipped a vendor card (a tattoo-artist business), two 'Coming Soon' placeholder cards, and 3 exact-duplicate repeats of guests already picked under a different photo (Milo Beasley, Patty Hawkins, Morgan Le Foy each appeared twice). Verify pass (2026-10-05): current -- the page's own text runs straight from the 'Voice Actors' heading into a named, scheduled guest ('Kevin Woo at Animate! Orlando All 3 Days') with no 'coming soon' wording visible, and one filename is explicitly '2027-A_-JustinCook...jpg'; the literal 'Coming Soon' value in every candidate's extracted section field is a GalaxyCon template artifact, confirmed by the same pattern on the San Jose page (see galaxycon-san-jose notes), not a real unannounced status. Refute attempt (2026-10-05): trimmed 34 -> 1 -- the 'current' call relied only on template-level date text; a fresh per-guest check of the cached image filenames shows most of the grid is explicitly tagged '26-' (2026) -- including both copies each of Milo Beasley, Patty Hawkins, Tyler Wood, Morgan Le Foy, Eve Talisman Cosplay and others -- i.e. last cycle's images recycled under the 2027 header, with zero other filename carrying a 2027 tag; only Justin Cook's image is explicitly tagged '2027-A!-JustinCook...jpg', so only he has real proof and the rest (including untagged cards like Kevin Woo, which is the same '2026-GC-KevinWoo' asset also seen stale on GalaxyCon San Jose) are dropped for lack of edition-specific evidence.
